strings.Tools_Subtitle: JiYu classroom bypass, broadcast window control, and boss key.
strings.Tools_Status_HostMissing: Bypass component is not ready (JiYu may not be installed, or startup was blocked by security software)
strings.Tools_Bypass_Desc: The client injects a hook into the JiYu student process at startup. Screen broadcasts are no longer forced fullscreen or topmost, and the window can be resized freely. Turning this off restores JiYu's original behavior immediately.
strings.Tools_AllowTop_Title: Allow broadcast window to stay topmost
strings.Tools_AllowTop_Desc: Off by default: the broadcast window is never forced topmost. When enabled, it only applies when you click Topmost manually.
strings.Tools_Boss_Desc: Press the shortcut on any page to force the current broadcast window into fullscreen and topmost. Only works while the teacher is broadcasting.
strings.Tools_Boss_PressKeys: Press a combination (must include Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win)
strings.Tools_Boss_CancelHint: Recording shortcut. Press Esc to cancel.
strings.Tools_Boss_NeedModifier: The shortcut must include at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Win.
strings.Tools_Boss_NoBroadcast: There is no active broadcast window.
strings.Tools_Boss_NotRunning: The JiYu host is not running; the boss key cannot be triggered.
strings.Tools_Saved_HostNotRunning: Settings saved. The JiYu host is not running; they will be applied automatically on next startup.
strings.Tools_Panic_Desc: Notify every currently online user to quit this app immediately, including yourself. Use it in an emergency to take everyone offline at once.
strings.Tools_Panic_ConfirmBody: Every online user, including you, will quit this app immediately. Unsent chat input will be lost.
strings.Tools_Panic_NotConnected: Not connected to the online server, so other users cannot be notified.
strings.Tools_Panic_Sent: All online users have been notified to quit.
strings.Toolbox_Subtitle: Everyday utilities, ready when you need them
